lcc_original: 水從地上不斷地退去；過了一百五十天，水就消減。
notes: Hebrew inf-abs idiom הלוך ושוב (halak+shuv = 'going and returning', expressing continuous action) is rendered in UNV as 漸 with both inf-abs tags <WH01980><WTH8800><WH07725><WTH8800>; in LCC this idiom becomes the adverb 不斷地 ('unceasingly'), so both inf-abs tags attach there, while the main verb tag <WH07725><WTH8799> attaches to 退去.
UNV 漸消 → LCC 消減 (both gloss H02637 חָסֵר 'to decrease/abate'); tag attaches to 消減, leaving 就 unannotated as a Chinese connective particle.
LCC uses semicolon ；between the two clauses where UNV uses 。— LCC punctuation preserved exactly.
